title: REPLACEMENT OF FRONT OIL SEAL COMPONENTS
ocr_text:
REAR AXLE AND SUSPENSION — IRS Type Differential

REPLACEMENT OF FRONT OIL SEAL COMPONENTS

Companion Flange
See page RA-34
Oil Seal
Oil Slinger
Front Bearing
Spacer

Non-reusable part

RA003B

1. REMOVE DIFFERENTIAL (See page RA-20)

2. REMOVE COMPANION FLANGE
(See step 10 on page RA-24)

3. REMOVE OIL SEAL
(a) Using SST, remove the oil seal from the housing.
SST 09308-10010
(b) Remove the oil slinger.

SST
RA007B

4. REMOVE FRONT BEARING AND BEARING SPACER
(See step 12 on page RA-25)

5. INSTALL NEW BEARING SPACER AND FRONT BEARING
(a) Install a new bearing spacer on the shaft.
(b) Install the front bearing on the shaft.

New Spacer

RA043B

6. INSTALL OIL SLINGER AND NEW OIL SEAL
(a) Install the oil slinger facing as shown.
(b) Using SST, drive in a new oil seal.
SST 09316-60010
Oil seal drive in depth: 1.5 mm (0.059 in.)
(c) Apply MP grease to the oil seal lip.

SST

Oil Slinger
